changelog: ClawHub-safe: remove subprocess and LYGO_STACK_ROOT exec; pure in-package stdlib; declare permissions
summary: Run when the user asks for TraumaCodex, biometric IBI timing → dual offline/online digests, LDQ-style waveform from a timing list, or mirror dig seals. Pure local stdlib: no network, no subprocess, no external stack execution. Input is inter-beat interval milliseconds (demo set or --ibi-file), not a medical device. Not for health diagnosis or treatment. Healing codes mean protocol digests only.
